task.text: Established over 100 years ago, Unilever is one of the world’s largest consumer goods companies. They are known for their great brands in different divisions, such as Foods & Refreshments, Home Care, and Beauty & Personal Care. Apply the BCG matrix on their different products, mention two examples on each quadrant (Stars – Cash Cows – Question Marks – Dogs). Explain in detail.
